name: Markets Morning
audience: a retail investor in India who wants to understand markets, personal finance and the economy well enough to make their own decisions

markets.label: Markets
markets.focus: Indian and global equity markets, central banks, earnings that moved markets

money.label: Personal Finance
money.focus: taxes, mutual funds, insurance, loans and practical money decisions for Indian households

economy.label: Economy
economy.focus: inflation, jobs, trade and policy, explained for a non-economist

learning.goal: the fundamentals of investing and economics, with enough working understanding to read financial news critically

tracks.name: Investing
lessons: Compounding and why time in the market matters
Stocks vs bonds vs gold vs real estate

tracks.name: Economy
lessons: What inflation is and how CPI is measured
How the RBI repo rate moves loan and deposit rates
Why the rupee moves against the dollar

challenge_types: Portfolio: allocate a sum across options for a specific goal and justify it
Calculation: work out returns, EMIs or tax with concrete numbers
News reading: explain what a market move means for an ordinary investor
Decision: choose between two financial products for a specific person
